# Georgia Biliouli (rgbil)

> Portfolio of Georgia Biliouli, a graphic designer working in branding, packaging and cover art.

Georgia Biliouli is a graphic designer based in Greece, working across Branding, Packaging, Covers & Posters. Contact: georgia.biliouli@gmail.com

## Work

- [Noi Coffee Roasters](https://www.behance.net/gallery/254284897/Noi-Coffee-Roasters-(Coffee-Brand)): Coffee Brand
- [National Theater Of Greece & Show](https://www.behance.net/gallery/254280911/National-Theater-Of-Greece-Show-(Rebranding)): Rebranding
- [El Gato](https://www.behance.net/gallery/254237883/El-Gato-(Pasta-Brand)): Pasta Brand
- [Archaid](https://www.behance.net/gallery/254234557/Archaid-(Architecture-Studio)): Architecture Studio
